primary_diagnosis: Chronic Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with Reflux Dyspepsia
secondary_diagnoses: Secondary Sleep Disturbance / Insomnia due to nocturnal reflux
clinical_reasoning: A 2-3 year chronicity of burning sensation radiating from chest to upper abdomen with postprandial nausea/vomiting feeling strongly indicates chronic gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) with reflux-mediated dyspepsia. Nocturnal regurgitation or burning frequently leads to secondary sleep disturbance. Normal fasting blood sugar rules out diabetic gastroparesis.
recommended_tests: Upper GI Endoscopy (EGD) to assess for reflux esophagitis or Barrett's esophagus
H. pylori testing (Rapid Urease Test or Stool Antigen)
